title: Hyperspherical Simplex Representations for Backward-Compatible Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.29550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, and updating deployed models can alter their internal feature representations, affecting applications built upon them. In retrieval systems, such updates often require complete gallery re-indexing, a computationally expensive process at scale. Existing backward-compatibility methods enable direct comparison of representations from updated and earlier models, avoiding re-indexing. However, they typically require compatibility-specific training, learned mapping functions, or architectural modifications, and often depend explicitly on the previous model. We propose hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits for backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models. translated_title: 用于后向兼容检索的超球面单纯形表示
translated_abstract: 训练现代AI模型的成本日益高昂，而更新已部署的模型可能会改变其内部特征表示，从而影响基于这些模型构建的应用。在检索系统中，此类更新通常需要对图库进行完整的重新索引，这在大规模场景下是一个计算代价高昂的过程。现有的后向兼容方法能够直接比较更新后模型与早期模型的表示，从而避免重新索引。然而，这些方法通常需要专门的兼容性训练、学习到的映射函数或架构修改，并且往往显式依赖于先前的模型。我们提出由softmax输出和logits导出的超球面单纯形表示，用于在独立训练的模型之间实现后向兼容检索。这些表示利用由softmax交叉熵训练与独热标签所诱导的单纯形结构，作为跨模型更新的共同几何参考。
tldr: 提出由softmax输出和logits导出的超球面单纯形表示，利用softmax交叉熵训练所诱导的单纯形结构作为跨模型更新的共同几何参考，无需专门兼容训练、映射函数或依赖旧模型即可实现独立训练模型间的后向兼容检索。
en_tdlr: Proposes hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits, leveraging the simplex structure induced by softmax cross-entropy training as a common geometric reference to enable backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models without compatibility-specific training, mapping functions, or reliance on the previous model.
